issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 13 unused public symbols across legacy_sase_shell_syntax, receipts, finalizer dirty-repos, and TUI helpers
issue.description: Master's _lint-symvision stage reports 13 file-local public symbols; see the CI failure body for the list and origins.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic whole-repo lint: `.venv/bin/symvision src/sase ...` (the `_lint-symvision` recipe) reports the same 13 "Unused public functions/classes" on every run of master 19abe261d4. It was observed in `sase tool run -k check` run 109aa65ee68b1d6365d33d297620dfab by the sase-1aq.10.7.5 land agent. That agent's diff touches only src/sase/dispatch/mutations.py, src/sase/integrations/_mobile_agent_deps.py and two mobile-agent tests, none of which define or use these symbols. The symbols, and the commits that introduced them:

- ModelShortcutExtraEdit (src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_model_shortcut_edits.py) ← e922c424e2 (sase-1ao.2)
- agents_prompt_archive_identity, sdd_store_identities (src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer_state/_dirty_repos.py) ← 7cdde2b32a
- intent_accept (src/sase/monitor/no_new_receipt.py) ← 9e8a65ad2a (sase-1ah.6)
- is_bypassed (src/sase/tool/receipts.py) ← 281147666b (sase-1ah.4)
- normalize_continuation_mode, normalize_gate_spec_block, normalize_persisted_continuation_mode, normalize_reclaim_config (src/sase/agent/legacy_sase_shell_syntax.py) ← d5fc75864f (sase-1ab.3; flag bead sase-1ar retires this module)
- normalize_creation_reason (src/sase/bead/cli_crud_create.py) ← d588a461bc (sase-1ap.2)
- preview_project_value (src/sase/ace/tui/modals/_prompt_history_preview.py) ← bdea1b3f80
- scheduled_routines_panel_title (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/axe_display/_panel_titles.py) ← 3f5d34e9fd (sase-17a.1)
- unmet_ancestor_folds (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/navigation/_agent_reveal.py) ← ee22eb305c (sase-19i.1)

A later refactor or split probably made the callers file-local. Privatize or delete each symbol per the symvision memory note, or add an epic whitelist only where an open epic still needs it.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the sase-1aq.10.7.5 land agent: master's whole-repo symvision gate is red on symbols unrelated to that epic, and no existing task tracks them.

payload.description: Four of the 13 symbols live in legacy_sase_shell_syntax.py from sase-1ab.3; coordinate with the rename epic and flag bead sase-1ar

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on 2026-09-27 in workspace sase_19 while landing the agents group-fold repaint: sase tool run check run 0a428cd8003581b548493bfdfb5e1a12 stops at lint (symvision) with 27 NEW unused-public items. The 13 symbols in this bead are all present, plus 14 more in the same backlog: BlockState, ViewContent, distinct_layouts, forced_block_mode, forced_deck_mode, layout_signature, next_view, resolve_view (decks/view_policy.py), badge_variants (decks/view_badge.py), with_panel_view (decks/model.py), cap_text, choose_headline (finalizers/status_summary.py), journal_path (finalizers/progress.py), operation_filename (finalizers/operation_records.py). Layering note: the run first reported only the private-import error _root_represents_member (agent_session_members.py <- _loaders/_meta_enrichment_status.py), which I renamed to public per the gate's own prescription; the 27 unused items were masked behind it and surfaced only after. Caution for the worker: normalize_creation_reason has live references in the linked sase-core checkout, so bulk deletion is unsafe; journal_path (21 files) and next_view (18 files) likewise need per-symbol treatment.

payload.entry: sase-1ab.10.1 resolved this epic’s four legacy_sase_shell_syntax symbols (normalize_continuation_mode, normalize_gate_spec_block, normalize_persisted_continuation_mode, normalize_reclaim_config now have non-test consumers); just _lint-symvision no longer lists them — remaining failure is foreign _mapping in finalizer_run_view.py
